title: fix(plugin-form): a form section naming a field the object lacks draws no control
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbX2BpbF4EuTV9iEpP8DVMBf)_

Fixes #29021

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：表单视图的分区里如果写了对象上不存在的字段名（拼错或字段已删除），tabbed / wizard / drawer / modal 四种布局不再为它画一个可编辑的输入框；simple 布局本来就不画。
- 为什么改：以前用户能在这个框里输入，保存时值被静默丢弃（保存只写对象声明过的字段），且因为“没改任何真实字段”，保存会把整条记录都发出去。lint 的 `form-field-unknown` 早就说这种字段“不会渲染”，现在表单与 lint 一致。
- 风险与回滚：只影响“对象 schema 已加载、且名字不在对象上、也没有 customFields 成员定义它”的分区条目；没有对象 schema 的表单（无数据源、由宿主 submitHandler 负责写入）保持原样。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts`（`fromObjectSchema` 与 `buildSectionFields`），`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/unknownSectionField-29021.test.tsx`，`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/flatFields.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/unknownSectionField-29021.test.tsx`，预期 8 个用例全绿（四种布局各两条）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`fromObjectSchema` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts`) used to answer a name the object does not declare with a bare `{ name, label: name, type: 'input' }` stub. The four arms that build a section with no field pool (`tabbed`, `wizard`, `drawer`, `modal`) drew it as a live text box labelled with the raw name. It now answers `undefined` when an object schema is resolved and does not declare the name, `normalizeSectionField` passes that through, and `buildSectionFields` drops the entry. This is the answer the lint's `FORM_FIELD_UNKNOWN` already gives ("silently skipped and never renders on the form") and the one the default arm's pool and `buildFlatFields` already gave.

What is still drawn, unchanged:

- a `customFields` member naming the field (it is a whole definition);
- a self-describing inline entry carrying its own `name` (shape 3);
- a bare name on a form with NO object schema at all, such as a form mounted without a data source whose host `submitHandler` owns the write (`submitTargetRefusal.test.tsx`). There is no object to call the name unknown, the lint likewise judges only a known object, and the value does reach that host.

An authored `type` or `label` on a spec `{ field }` entry does not make the field exist: such an entry is dropped too, as the lint reports it.

**Empty sections.** A section whose every member is unknown now builds no field. Each arm keeps whatever it already does with an empty section; nothing here changes that. On the default arm this is the existing behaviour pinned by `objectFormSectionMembers-8071` row 2 (the section is dropped whole, heading included).

**Design and preview paths.** No designer relies on the fallback. Studio's object form designer (`StudioDesignSurface`) renders a flat `object-form` with top-level `fields` (the `buildFlatFields` / pool path, which already skipped unknown names). The metadata-admin view preview (`ViewPreview`) renders the draft form view through the same `object-form` arms, so it now shows what the record form shows; the author's signal for the unknown name stays the lint's `form-field-unknown`.

`fromObjectSchema` and `normalizeSectionField` now return `FormField | undefined`. Neither is exported from the package entry (only `sectionEntryName` is), so the public surface is unchanged. `flatFields.ts` reads the new answer instead of its own duplicate declaration check.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/unknownSectionField-29021.test.tsx`: for each of `tabbed`, `wizard`, `drawer`, `modal`, an EDIT form of a real record whose section lists `title` beside `no_such_field` (bare name) and `{ field: 'other_ghost', label: 'Other ghost' }`:
  1. only `title` is drawn, no control and no label for either unknown name (the known input with its loaded value is the non-vacuity control);
  2. editing `title` and saving calls `dataSource.update('task', 't1', payload)` with `title: 'New title'` and no key for either unknown name.
- `sectionFields.test.ts`: `normalizeSectionField` builds nothing for an unknown name in both named shapes (also with an authored `type`); with `objectSchema: null` the bare stub is still built (the boundary); `buildSectionFields` drops unknown entries keeping known ones in order, builds `[]` for an all-unknown section, and still draws a `customFields` member and an inline entry.
- Existing rows that used an undeclared `ghost` field as a blank slate now use a declared bare field (`sectionFields.spec-parity.test.ts` declares `plain: { type: 'number' }`); `selectMultipleGroupLabel.test.tsx`'s "keeps its fallback type" row now pins that no field is built. Other call sites take `!` where the field is declared.

## Acceptance notes

- **Ablation.** Restoring the fallback (deleting `if (ctx.objectSchema != null) return undefined;` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 -> 0, blob restored to HEAD after) turned 7 cases red: the four "draws only the known field" rows and three `sectionFields.test.ts` rows. The four save rows stay green under the ablation, as expected: the stub's value was already stripped on save before this change (the card saw no `no_such_field` key either). They pin the save half so it cannot regress once the box is gone.
- **The whole-record PATCH (finding, save path unchanged).** Measured in the same harness with the fallback restored, typing `ghost` into the stub and saving sent `{"title":"Old title","notes":"kept"}`, every drawn field, on all four arms. That is `dirtyEditPayload` (`sanitize.ts`) by design: the unknown key is stripped, so the diff against the loaded record is empty, and an empty diff sends the whole payload so the save stays a real write. With this fix the ghost box is gone, so typing into it can no longer produce that save. A save with nothing changed still sends every drawn field (measured: the same payload on all four arms). That is the documented empty-diff rule, left as is per the card's ruling.
- **Publish-time validity (finding, out of lane).** `_diagnostics` on the metadata read door is the Zod verdict (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts`); `validateFormLayout`, which owns `form-field-unknown`, is wired into the authoring-rule registry (`os validate` / `os lint`) and not into the door, so a form view naming an unknown field still reads `valid: true` there. That belongs to `domain:server`; nothing under `packages/**` is touched here.
- **Dev showcase reproduction: NOT MEASURED.** It needs a full workspace build and a dev server. The record edit route renders the form view through `ObjectForm`'s `tabbed` arm, the same component the render pins drive.
